newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIA AUCTIONED RATE FALLS TO 220.02 PCT.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIA AUCTIONED RATE FALLS TO 220.02 PCT.

text.p: The average rate on Romania's central bank (BNR) refinancing funds fell to 220.02 percent at Thursday's auction from 226.08 percent last week, BNR data showed on Friday.
The Lombard rate, applied to overdraft credits and set by multiplying the average one-week auctioned rate by 1.6, is also expected to slip from last week's 361.73 percent.

The BNR's one-week funds offer of 500 billion lei, down from 600 billion last week, was slightly oversubscribed, with five banks bidding a total 508 billion lei at rates ranging from 220 percent -- the minimum permitted rate -- to 221.
